name: 8631-batchdecode-dsv2lite-dp8
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat. Ungated on the Hub, ~30 GB in bf16. The -Chat variant because the client posts to /v1/chat/completions.
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8 with data-parallel attention at dp-size 8, so each rank computes attention over its own requests while the dense and expert blocks are tensor-parallel over the whole batch.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, bf16, 27 layers, MLA attention, 64 routed experts with 6 per token plus 2 shared. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 8192 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 1024 prompt tokens and 1024 generated tokens, both fixed (stdev 0). `ignore_eos` and `temperature: 0` are set through `backend.extras.body`, so every request generates exactly 1024 tokens. Seed 42.
purpose: A chat assistant on a mixture-of-experts model writing 1024-token replies for 1024 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. One flat `key: value` per line; an indented block is skipped.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration and modeling modules.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true

# Every prompt is an independent synthetic draw, so a radix tree has nothing to reuse.
disable-radix-cache: true

# What the engine derives for itself at this shape on an 80 GB card, written down so it cannot move.
mem-fraction-static: 0.78

# The longest request this workload can draw is 1024 + 1024 = 2048, so this truncates nothing.
context-length: 4096

random-seed: 42
